problem_framing: Predict broad 2018 disengagement using only activity observed through 2017-12-31.
target_definition: 2018 cancellation OR at least 6 consecutive zero-flight months during 2018 (among members active in the program on 2017-12-31).
model_selection_metric: Mean five-fold average precision on the training split; test split is held out until final evaluation.

ab_test_design.historical_assignment: None in the supplied files; no treatment effect or causal lift is estimated.
ab_test_design.eligibility: Enrolled and uncancelled at 2017-12-31, at least one flight during 2017, and at least 3 months since the last 2017 flight.
ab_test_design.historical_control_proxy: Observed any-flight rate in Jan-Mar 2018 for the eligible historical cohort. This is a baseline reference, not a randomized control arm.
ab_test_design.primary_outcome_for_proposed_trial: At least one flight during the 90 days after randomized assignment (intent-to-treat).
ab_test_design.treatment_example: Personalized route reminder plus a pre-specified points offer versus business-as-usual communication.
ab_test_design.randomization_unit: Loyalty Number, stratified by predicted risk tier.
ab_test_design.power_assumptions: Two-sided two-proportion normal approximation, alpha=0.05, power=0.80, equal allocation, 10% allowance for unusable follow-up.
